title: Extension Committee Standard: Measuring a First Extension from the Supporting Document in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**Which request.** For the first extension on a Cedarline Summit loan's Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case whose borrower has died, the extension request the grant rests on is the most recently received extension request on the case that is still awaiting a decision. Among extension requests received on the same day, the more recently received is the one recorded later by its recorded date and time. A request re-filed on the day of the request it replaces is therefore the one a grant rests on.

**Rule.** That request's supporting document sets how far the measured extension runs from the current resolution deadline:

- **Financing commitment:** to 60 calendar days after the commitment date.
- **Listing agreement dated more than 90 calendar days before the request was received:** to 150 calendar days after the listing date. This is a listing marketed a full quarter without a sale, so the end falls a month short of its six-month term and its price is reviewed sooner.
- **Listing agreement dated no more than 90 calendar days before the request was received:** to 180 calendar days after the listing date, the end of its six-month term.

## Both sides of the 90-day listing age (hypothetical; request received on 1 June)

| Listing agreement dated | Days before receipt | Measured to |
|---|---|---|
| 3 March | 90 | 180 days after 3 March |
| 2 March | 91 | 150 days after 2 March |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A financing commitment is dated 10 April and the current resolution deadline is 20 April. The end is 60 days after 10 April, which is 9 June. The measured extension runs from 20 April to 9 June: 50 calendar days.
